mechanical_coverage_statement: All source archive files, record metadata definitions, declared fields, parsed source operations, decorated exposed operations, and report metadata definitions were inventoried. This does not establish full behavioral equivalence.

known_limitations.limitation: All 85 structural-parser misses are resolved in the supplemental semantic catalog. Other mechanically parsed expressions retain the stated evaluation-context caveats.
Callable and calculation discovery parses server source. Client scripts, component behavior, database query expressions, markup templates, and embedded scripts require separate semantic review.
Extracted trees have not all been dimensionally checked or linked to preconditions and acceptance outcomes; text operations can appear in the inventory.
Metadata inventory does not exhaust computed defaults, implicit indexes, runtime field overrides, calculated values, and validations in behavior code.
Static report columns are partial where branches construct columns dynamically. Report result equivalence requires scenario comparisons.
Unrecognized abbreviated source terms are replaced with opaque source-term identifiers instead of speculative expansions; original values remain discoverable by evidence and digests.
Executable, markup, address, and expressive source values are represented by digests when they cannot safely become neutral factual data.
